title: Retry / resume
summary: Resuming a failed run restores the QA copies its failure retired only for shared rows and current members. Removing a member takes over its copies the failure retired, so a removed member's QA never returns to hold the run. A driver call refused as run_busy, lock_timeout or statement_cancelled is not a failure: a busy approval stage is held for the driver's next check, other calls repeat after 15s, 30s, then 60s, and past that cap the driver stops with deployment_run_stayed_busy, leaving the run unchanged for `yoke watch deploy -- RUN-ID`.
